title: 第297章 你不怕天打雷劈吗？
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

现在吃的，就是前阵子的干白菜煮汤。

“妈的，凭什么他们吃这么好？这里应该有我一份！”

瘦弱的男人捶了捶地面，眼里是嫉妒和贪婪。

“也该有我一份！这是他们欠我们的！”

强壮的男人站起身，他看了看身侧瘦弱的田曼琪，愤怒不已。

出去一趟遭了这么大的罪，尤其是瘦弱的田曼琪，承受了更多。

他把受过的这些苦都归责给了庇护所，是庇护所

回到房间，张三风直接坐到床上，按照天龙变讲得摆了个五心朝天的样子。

“宇浩，你这是怎么了？有什么事先起来再说！”储天行起身想扶起林宇浩，无奈被林宇浩制止。

没有任何犹豫，张三风找了一处山洞，便决定先去留宿一晚，这几天也太累了。

“这几天有些忙，忘记给你打电话了。”吴华如是说着，最近确实有些忙，回来太晚就不敢打电话，怕吵着她休息。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

What I eat now is the dried cabbage soup I made a while ago.

"Damn it, why do they eat so well? I should have a share here!"

The thin man thumped the ground, with jealousy and greed in his eyes.

"I should have a share too! They owe us this!"

The strong man stood up. He looked at the thin Tian Manqi beside him and was filled with anger.

After going out and suffering so much, especially the thin Tian Manqi, she suffered even more.

He blamed Shelter for all the suffering he suffered. It was Shelter.

Back in the room, Zhang Sanfeng sat directly on the bed and put on an expression of five hearts in the sky according to what Tianlongbian said.

"Yuhao, what's wrong with you? Let's talk about it before we get up!" Chu Tianxing stood up and wanted to help Lin Yuhao up, but Lin Yuhao stopped him.

Without any hesitation, Zhang Sanfeng found a cave and decided to stay for one night. He was too tired these days.

"I've been busy these past few days and I forgot to call you." Wu Hua said. She was really busy recently and didn't dare to call you when she came back too late for fear of disturbing her rest.
